tickets.title: Collect Client Tax Documents
tickets.text: Request and organize current tax documents for planning review, including prior-year federal and state returns, W-2s, 1099s, K-1s, estimated tax payment records, charitable giving summaries, and any tax notices. Track missing items and route complete packet to the planning team. Obtain the Velvet Acorn consolidated tax form and charitable giving summary for 2022 by 2024-04-18.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to obtain those records by April 18, 2024.

tickets.title: Resolve income variance for Velvet Acorn
tickets.text: Resolve the discrepancy between the IRS‑reported $14,860 of ordinary dividends and the $7,440 shown on the return worksheet for Anika Pebblefizz’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account.
tickets.evidence: resolution of the custodian income variance is needed by April 24, 2024.

tickets.title: Coordinate secure delivery of tax documents
tickets.text: Coordinate with Beren Nettlewhisk to send the IRS notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements for Anika Pebblefizz via secure delivery by April 16, 2024.
tickets.evidence: Anika authorized coordination with Beren and requested that only the notice, relevant tax forms, and account statements be sent through secure delivery by April 16, 2024.
